rules.message: PHI over plain HTTP is a HIPAA violation — use HTTPS.
rules.recommendation: All PHI transmission must use TLS 1.2 or higher. Verify certificate validation is not disabled.

rules.message: Social Security Number detected — never store in source.
rules.recommendation: Never store or transmit SSNs in plain text. Tokenise or hash with a per-record salt if a unique identifier is required.

rules.recommendation: De-identify PHI per Safe Harbor or Expert Determination methods before processing. Document the de-identification approach.

rules.description: Require compliance-officer approval before exporting PHI-shaped data (SSN, DOB, patient_id, MRN) via bulk write/curl/scp
rules.message: PHI export requires compliance-officer approval — HIPAA 164.308(a)(4) minimum-necessary rule.
rules.recommendation: Bulk export of PHI-shaped fields must have compliance sign-off. Verify minimum-necessary scope, encryption at rest on destination, and access log capture before approving.
